answer: Rotating Beacon Admission. Each epoch, a public randomness beacon drives a verifiable shuffle that assigns arriving agents to admission slots; a slot opens only when its assigned seed matches, so attackers cannot precompute which identities gain entry. Unused slots expire and their fees are forfeited like dead cedar. To hold N ready identities, an attacker must fund every slot across many epochs, paying recurring per-identity fees and idle timber costs while most slots miss.
